subject: Menu screen
text: Press X on the normal screen to bring up the menu.

evidence.quote: Press the X button while on the normal screen to bring it up.  Here is a chart showing the controls:

subject: Menu: Item
text: Item: check inventory and/or use items.

evidence.quote: *Item: Check your inventory and/or use one or more items.

subject: Menu: Status
text: Status: see stats, experience and experience needed for the next level.

evidence.quote: *Status: See your stats, experience, and how much more experience is needed to go to the next level.

subject: Menu: Special
text: Special: see special attacks and use Mallow's HP Rain or Toadstool's Therapy or Group Hug.

evidence.quote: *Special: See your special attacks, and/or use Mallow's HP Rain or Toadstool's Therapy or Group Hug.

subject: Menu: Equip
text: Equip: equip and take off weapons, armor, and accessories.

evidence.quote: *Equip: Equip and take off weapons, armor, and accessories.

subject: Menu: Special Item
text: Special Item: see inventory of special items.

evidence.quote: *Special Item: See your inventory of special items.

subject: Menu: Map
text: Map: unlocked by getting the Map from the Chancellor; shows the world map and your position.

evidence.quote: *Map (get from Chancellor): See the world map and where you are on it.

subject: Menu: Star Pieces
text: Star Pieces: appears after defeating Mack; shows how many star pieces you have.

evidence.quote: *Star Pieces (after defeating Mack): See how many star pieces you have.

subject: Menu: Switch
text: Switch: appears after Bowser joins; swaps allies available for battle.

evidence.quote: *Switch (after Bowser joins): Switch allies available for battle.

subject: Menu: Game
text: Game: appears after buying Beetle Mania in Mushroom Kingdom; lets you play Beetle Mania.

evidence.quote: *Game (buy Beetle Mania in Mushroom Kingdom, see Mini-Games) Select if you wish to play Beetle Mania.

subject: A Button
text: A is Attack: press A once to see weapon and pick a target, again to attack; time it per weapon.

evidence.quote: A Button: Attack: This one you will probably be using most of the time.  Press A once to see what weapon you have and to pick a target.  Press A again to attack.  To time it, press the A button at the time the different weapons specify (see Timed Attacks under each character).

subject: Defense
text: B then Defense halves damage, or cuts it by 3/4 with a timed block.

evidence.quote: your character will shield themselves and cut damage by 1/2 (if you do a timed block here also, it'll be cut by 3/4!)

subject: Run Away
text: Running away can be unavailable if the option is deactivated, a character has a status problem, or the game won't allow it.

evidence.quote: Sometimes you can't run away because the option is deactivated

subject: X Button
text: X is Item: press X for inventory, choose an item and a target, then press again; sometimes a freebie occurs, possibly by timing.

evidence.quote: Sometimes you'll get "a freebie".  It either occurs randomly, or maybe you time it like your attack and defense...

subject: Y Button
text: Y is Special: press Y to choose an attack, again for the target, again to commence; unavailable if not learned, not enough FP, or no use.

evidence.quote: Y Button: Special: Don't use this one too often, unless you have plenty of FP. Press Y once to choose an available attack (unavailable if not learned, not enough FP, or no use for like Toadstool's Come Back).  Press Y again to decide who to use it on, then press Y again to commence the attack.  Use the specific directions for each attack to pull them off right.

subject: Status: Normal
text: Normal status: All commands available, no effects.

evidence.quote: *Normal: All commands available, no effects

subject: Status: Fear
text: Fear status: All commands available, all stats cut in half.

evidence.quote: *Fear: All commands available, all stats cut in half

subject: Status: Poison
text: Poison status: All commands available, HP lost each battle turn (HP divided by 10, decimals dropped).

evidence.quote: *Poison: All commands available, HP taken off each battle turn (figured out by taking your HP, dividing it by 10, and the decimals are cut off without rounding)

subject: Status: Sleep
text: Sleep status: No commands available, vulnerable; wakes after a normal attack or when out of HP.

evidence.quote: *Sleep: No commands available, vulnerable to attacks, wake up after normal attack or out of HP

subject: Status: Silence
text: Silence status: Special command not available.

evidence.quote: *Silence: Special command not available, no other effects

subject: Status: Scarecrow
text: Scarecrow status: Attack and item commands not available.

evidence.quote: *Scarecrow: Attack and item commands not available, no other effects

subject: Status: Mushroom
text: Mushroom status: No commands available, HP regained each battle turn (same system as poison).

evidence.quote: *Mushroom: No commands available, HP regained each battle turn (same system as poison).

subject: Status cures
text: Non-normal statuses can be healed with Able Juice, Freshen Up, or Toadstool's Therapy and Group Hug.

evidence.quote: The non-normal ones can be healed with a Able Juice, Freshen Up, or Toadstool's Therapy and Group Hug attacks.

subject: Battle display
text: Mario is always first; the second character appears once Geno is gained.

evidence.quote: 1st Character (always Mario)

subject: Special attack classes
text: Attacks are classified into Normal, Jump, Fire, Thunder, Ice, Fear, Poison, Sleep and Silence; enemies may have 0 damage or large weaknesses to a class.

evidence.quote: Some enemies have special defenses against certain attacks (A.K.A. 0 Damage taken) or weaknesses (A.K.A. tons and tons of damage).  The attacks are divided into 9 classifications (8 really, but I added N/A as Normal).  The special attacks AND items are listed next to each category.
